info.title: Calibration Ledger — trust a forecast, with evidence (beta)
info.description:
Given a claim from an organization (IMF, OECD, Fed/FOMC, SPF, ECB SPF, or a listed issuer), returns that organization's track record: error distribution, intervals, bias, band coverage, worst misses with source links — or honest 'no coverage' (free). Organizations only, never people.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/calibration-ledger
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/calibration-ledger
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/calibration-ledger

application/json.schema:
{
  "title": "Calibration Ledger input",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "title": "Mode",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "default": "text",
      "enum": [
        "text",
        "lookup",
        "score",
        "compare",
        "issuer",
        "coverage",
        "verify"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Text: any claim in words",
        "Lookup: a live number by source/series/geo/period",
        "Score: a source's record on a series",
        "Compare: rank sources on one question",
        "Issuer: an issuer's promise-keeping record",
        "Coverage: what the ledger can answer",
        "Verify: provenance of a claim id"
      ],
      "description": "text = hand it a sentence (\"The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027\"). lookup/score/compare use structured fields.",
      "prefill": "lookup"
    },
    "claim_text": {
      "title": "Claim (text mode)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textarea",
      "prefill": "The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027.",
      "description": "Free-text claim for text mode (e.g. \"The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027\")."
    },
    "source": {
      "title": "Source organization",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "imf_weo | oecd_eo | fed_sep | spf | ecb_spf | pbo, or an issuer name; optional in text mode",
      "prefill": "oecd_eo"
    },
    "series": {
      "title": "Series",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "CORE_INFL_A",
        "CORE_PCE_INFL",
        "CPI_INFL",
        "CURRENT_ACCOUNT_PCTGDP",
        "EMPLOY_GROWTH_A",
        "FEDFUNDS",
        "GDP_DEFLATOR_A",
        "GOV_BALANCE_PCTGDP",
        "GOV_GROSS_DEBT_PCTGDP",
        "HICP_INFL_M",
        "LONG_RATE",
        "NGDP_GROWTH_Q",
        "PCE_INFL",
        "PGDP_INFL_Q",
        "RCONSUM_GROWTH_A",
        "RCONSUM_GROWTH_Q",
        "REXPORT_GROWTH_A",
        "RGDP_GROWTH_A",
        "RGDP_GROWTH_Q",
        "RIMPORT_GROWTH_A",
        "RINVEST_GROWTH_A",
        "RNRESIN_GROWTH_Q",
        "RRESINV_GROWTH_Q",
        "SHORT_RATE",
        "UNEMP_RATE",
        "UNEMP_RATE_M"
      ],
      "description": "Generated from rules.yaml — every series the ledger resolves.",
      "prefill": "RGDP_GROWTH_A"
    },
    "geo": {
      "title": "Geography (ISO3 / EA / USA)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "ISO3 country code, EA, or USA. Required for most score/lookup/compare calls.",
      "prefill": "CAN"
    },
    "target_period": {
      "title": "Target period (YYYY, YYYYQn, YYYY-MM)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "Target period as YYYY, YYYYQn, or YYYY-MM when looking up a specific claim.",
      "prefill": "2027"
    },
    "point": {
      "title": "Claimed value",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "Numeric claimed value for lookup mode (string so decimals stay exact).",
      "prefill": "1.8"
    },
    "published_at": {
      "title": "Claim date (YYYY-MM-DD)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "When the claim was published (YYYY-MM-DD), for lookup/verify.",
      "prefill": "2026-06-01"
    },
    "horizon_bucket": {
      "title": "Horizon bucket",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "0-4m",
        "4-9m",
        "9-15m",
        "15-24m",
        "24-36m",
        "36m+"
      ],
      "description": "Optional horizon bucket filter for score mode."
    },
    "band_kind": {
      "title": "Band kind (score mode)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "select",
      "enum": [
        "central_tendency",
        "range"
      ],
      "description": "For Fed SEP score mode: central_tendency or range."
    },
    "claim_id": {
      "title": "Claim id (verify mode)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "Ledger claim id for verify mode."
    },
    "issuer": {
      "title": "Issuer (issuer mode)",
      "type": "string",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "description": "Organization name as it appears on its releases/filings (e.g. Salesforce Inc). Both records are returned: dated promises (newswires) and numeric guidance (EDGAR)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "mode"
  ]
}
